programs.title: Free Education for All
programs.imageAlt: Children studying together in a classroom
programs.intro: Every child deserves a safe, supportive place to learn. Our free education program helps remove the cost and access barriers that keep children out of school.
programs.story: We work with local educators and families to provide consistent lessons, patient support, and the confidence children need to keep learning.

programs.title: Digital Learning
programs.intro: Digital skills open doors to education, work, and connection. We give children practical experience with computers and technology in a welcoming environment.
programs.story: Our mentors make technology approachable through guided projects that build curiosity, problem-solving, and the confidence to try something new.

programs.title: Books and School Supplies
programs.imageAlt: Books, notebooks, and school supplies ready for students
programs.intro: The right tools can change how a child feels about school. We provide books, notebooks, stationery, and learning materials so every student can take part with confidence.
programs.story: From a first school kit to a new set of reading books, each resource is chosen with teachers and communities so it meets a real need.

programs.title: Girls' Education
programs.imageAlt: Girls participating in a learning activity
programs.intro: When girls can learn, communities grow stronger. This program supports equal access to education and helps girls pursue their goals with confidence.
programs.story: We pair learning support with encouragement, mentorship, and family conversations that help girls stay engaged in school and imagine new possibilities.

programs.title: After-School Learning
programs.imageAlt: Children taking part in an after-school lesson
programs.intro: A little extra time and support can make a lasting difference. Our after-school sessions help children practise, ask questions, and enjoy learning at their own pace.
programs.story: Mentors create calm, encouraging sessions where homework becomes manageable and reading becomes something children look forward to.

programs.title: Early Childhood Learning
programs.intro: The early years shape a child’s relationship with learning. We use play, stories, and hands-on activities to build strong foundations for school and life.
programs.story: Children learn best when they feel safe and curious, so our educators create joyful spaces where every question and discovery is welcome.
